scope: Private-file and MockBackend software checks only; no real HID or product updater execution.
implementation: Canonical device TOML guard with operation ID and pinned SHA persisted and fsynced before EffectsPossible/first hold or flash. Disk intent retained.
Journal shares originating PersistenceStore state gate. Ordinary settings writes and profile transactions cannot create, clear or replace guarded settings.
Manager pre-open guard scan blocks LCDV2 replay even after journal deletion and changed serial/path. Invalid settings fail closed.
Pre-guard full serde schema accepts unguarded settings and rejects guarded unknown field. This qualifies audited previous reader only.
Transport mock reads settings anchor and journal marker on every PWM/chunk/activation call. No clearing API.

checks.native_gui: not run; no GUI source change

remaining: Global admission and joined in-flight jobs, fresh owner snapshot/assets and checked quiescence enforced by coordinator.
Qualified no-effects or fresh target/version reconnect resolution, no automatic retry/restoration.
Armed-only pre-effects records still rely on journal; anchor is published after identity preflight before effects.
Arbitrary historical readers ignoring unknown fields and simultaneous deletion of both journal and settings not qualified.
External concurrent writers need coordinator ownership; no product Apply or hardware qualification.
